changelog: Vercel Deployment API Rewrite & Serverless Parity (v3.23.13): Fixed backend API 404 on Vercel deployments. Restored explicit /api/(.*) and /api rewrites in vercel.json mapping to canonical serverless entrypoint api/index.js with intelligent x-matched-path / x-forwarded-uri URL restoration in the serverless handler. Configured dual CommonJS module exports and provided api/[...slug].js fallback proxy.
